title: CharPaper suite manifest
description:
A CharPaper character suite: the `suite.toml` at the root of the suite's
folder.

animations.description:
Named animations, used to rename, pick or change how clips play. Files
in `animations/` that are not mentioned here are used whole, each clip
under its own name. Once a file is mentioned, only the clips listed
for it are used.

name.description: Name shown in the app. Defaults to the folder name.

schema.description: Version of this file's format. Use 1.

Ambient.description: Light that reaches everything evenly, so shadowed areas are not black.

color.description: sRGB color as [r, g, b], each 0.0 to 1.0.

Camera.description:
Which camera the app starts with, and where the built-in orbit camera
starts. The user can switch cameras, and orbit and zoom the orbit camera.

default.description:
Camera active at start: a file name in `cameras/` without its
extension, or `orbit` for the built-in orbit camera. Defaults to
`orbit`.

focus.description: The point the orbit camera orbits around, as [x, y, z]. Y is up.

pitch_deg.description: Angle above the horizon, in degrees.

radius.description: The orbit camera's distance from the focus point.

yaw_deg.description: Angle around the vertical axis, in degrees.

default_animation.description:
Animation played at start. Without one the character holds its rest
pose.

default_skin.description:
Skin worn at start: a file name in `skins/` without its extension.
Defaults to the first skin in name order.

model.description:
Path to the model (the armature), relative to this file. Only needed
when more than one .glb/.gltf sits next to this file.

clip.description:
The clip's name inside the file (the Blender action name). May be left
out when the file holds exactly one clip.

file.description: Path to the file holding the clip, relative to this file.

scene.description:
A .glb/.gltf scene, relative to this file. Defaults to the only one in
`environment/`, if any.

skybox.description:
A .ktx2 cubemap, relative to this file. Defaults to the only one in
`environment/`, if any.

skybox_brightness.description: How bright the skybox looks, in cd/m². Defaults to 1000.

Lighting.description: Scene lighting. Anything left out uses the app's defaults.

PlayMode.description: How the animation plays. Defaults to `loop`.

oneOf.description: Plays once, then returns to the default animation.

Post.description: Effects applied to the finished image.

exposure.description: Exposure compensation in EV stops; positive is brighter.

Sun.description: A distant light shining in one direction everywhere, like the sun.

color.description: sRGB color as [r, g, b], each 0.0 to 1.0.

direction.description:
The direction the light travels as [x, y, z], not where it comes from.
Y is up.

illuminance.description:
Brightness in lux. Overcast daylight is about 1000, direct sunlight
about 100000.

Tonemapping.description: How bright colors are squeezed into what the screen can show.
